value.strategy: The management style is discretionary and integrates environmental, social / societal and governance (ESG) criteria. The investment process combines several strategies: a long/short directional strategy to optimize performance based on interest rate and inflation expectations; an interest rate curve strategy to exploit variations in spreads between long-term and short-term rates; an arbitrage strategy to seek relative value on various bond asset classes; and a credit strategy based on private sector bonds. The modified duration of the Product will stay between -3 and +7. The Product may use all types of eligible derivatives instruments (futures, options, swaps, CDS on indices, CDS) when suited to the management objective or to offer lower trading costs. Non-base currency exposure may be hedged to moderate currency exchange risks, not exceeding 30% of total assets.
value.philosophy: The management philosophy is centered on corporate responsibility, controversies, dialogue, and engagement with issuers. It utilizes a proprietary rating model (ABA, Above & Beyond Analysis) developed internally by DNCA for extra-financial analysis. The approach relies on the experience, relationships, and expertise of DNCA with the 'best in universe' method.
value.selection_process: The initial investment universe includes Government bonds from UN countries integrating the 17 Sustainable Development Goals, corporate bonds and related securities from OECD countries with a rating of at least B- by Standard & Poor's (or equivalent), and supranational agencies. Issuers with controversies or in severe breach of UN Global Compact Principles (e.g., human rights, anti-corruption) are excluded based on an internal approach. A strict controversial weapons exclusion and sectorial exclusion policy is implemented. The investment process incorporates internal scoring based on extra-financial analysis through the proprietary ABA model. At least 90% of securities (excluding cash, cash equivalents, derivatives, and money market funds) undergo extra-financial analysis, and 20% of the worst issuers are excluded. The Product will invest solely in securities with a rating of at least B- at the time of purchase. Fixed Income securities downgraded below B- during their lifetime may not exceed 10% of total assets. No more than 25% of total assets will be invested in bonds from non-OECD issuers.
value.asset_types: The Product mainly invests in fixed rate, floating rate, or inflation-indexed debt securities and negotiable debt. It may invest up to 100% of its total assets in convertible or exchangeable bonds, at most 20% in Contingent convertible bonds (Coco Bonds), and up to 10% of its asset may be exposed to the stock market through convertible bonds, synthetic convertibles bonds, or options on future equity markets. The Product may also invest up to 10% of its net assets in units and/or shares of UCITS and/or other UCIs. It uses various derivatives instruments including futures, options, swaps, CDS on indices, and CDS. Securities can be denominated in any currency.
value.real_objectives: The Product seeks to provide, throughout the recommended investment period of more than three years, a higher performance, net of any fees, than the (cid:188)(cid:54)(cid:55)(cid:53)(cid:3) index plus 2%. This performance objective is sought by associating it with a lower annual volatility than 5% in normal market conditions.
value.fund_history: The share class described in this document was launched in December 2017.
